ambiguities.clause: task card Q6: 'a_k as a 17-bit integer' (spec object.fixed_schedule_replay: e_k(r) = a_{k,0} + <a_k, r>)
readings: bit j of the integer = coefficient of r_j (the M_D(E^j) block), LSB = r_0
ambiguities.why: matches the spec's own encodings: field element bit j = coefficient of t^j, and r_j = coefficient of t^j in x_R, so <a_k, r> = parity(a_k & x_R)
ambiguities.affects: only the integer values listed for a_k in Q6; K_exact, K_rank and the increases-rank flags are invariant under a fixed bit permutation

ambiguities.clause: spec object.zero_reduction_set: 'The leading-column set of that basis must equal the pivot column set'
readings: leading column = the FIRST nonzero column in the declared (descending degrevlex) column order, i.e. smallest column index
leading column = the last nonzero column (largest index)
ambiguities.why: the column pass processes columns in increasing index, so its pivot rows form an echelon basis whose leads are the smallest nonzero index; only this reading makes the spec's C-PASS equality a theorem. Z_D itself (span membership) does not depend on the reading
ambiguities.affects: only the C-PASS consistency check, not Z_D, |Z_D| or any trace

ambiguities.clause: spec object.zero_reduction_set: 'Z_D = {i : row i of M_D lies in the span of rows 0..i-1}' together with 'Zero rows are RETAINED'
readings: a zero row lies in every span (including the span of the empty set), so every zero row, including row 0 if zero, is in Z_D
zero rows are excluded from Z_D
ambiguities.why: forced by the definition of span; the spec's identity |Z_D| = R_D - rank_D also requires it
ambiguities.affects: Z_D and T_set only if M_4 has zero rows; the per-instance count zero_rows_in_M4 is recorded so the effect is visible

ambiguities.clause: spec object.curve: 'Draw (A, B) from seed S_curve (B != 0)' with seeds.generator numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed))
readings: R1: two scalar calls A = integers(0, 2^17), B = integers(0, 2^17), reject B = 0
R3: (A, B) = integers(0, 2^17, size=2), reject B = 0
other call patterns (dtype, endpoint, B before A) not tried
ambiguities.chosen: R1 as primary; R2 and R3 also computed and reported; all three declared before any draw
ambiguities.why: the clause fixes the stream but not the call pattern, and numpy's bounded-integer draws consume the stream differently for scalar and vector calls. The card calls a mismatch a finding about determinacy

ambiguities.clause: spec object.fixed_schedule_replay: 'replaying the op log once on M_D(E^0) and on each M_D(E^j)'
readings: M_D(E^j) = the Macaulay construction applied to the 17 rows of E^j read as Boolean polynomials (the construction is F_2-linear in the equations)
ambiguities.why: no other reading is coherent; linearity M_D(E(r)) = M_D(E^0) + sum_j r_j M_D(E^j) is CHECKED on every instance

ambiguities.clause: spec object.descended_system: 'the 17 x 172 coefficient matrix' E(r)
readings: the order of E(r)'s 172 columns is not specified
ambiguities.chosen: E(r) is held as the map monomial -> 17-bit coefficient word; no column order is needed
ambiguities.why: no requested quantity depends on E(r)'s internal column order; M_D uses its own declared column order

ambiguities.clause: task card Q3: match flags '(equal content)' at T_ops
readings: compare full T_ops content for every pair
compare by sha256 and confirm content when hashes are equal
ambiguities.chosen: sha256 comparison, with content re-derived and compared whenever hashes are equal
ambiguities.why: the spec compares traces by hash and, on equal hashes, by content. Different hashes imply different canonical encodings and so different content
ambiguities.affects: none in outcome; the confirmations are listed

ambiguities.clause: task card Q5: 'count / n, with the Clopper-Pearson 95% interval'
readings: two-sided equal-tailed exact interval (alpha/2 = 0.025 per tail); n = non-degenerate unsatisfiable targets of the 100-target subsample under THIS task's classification
ambiguities.why: standard definition; the card says 'reference YOU classify unsatisfiable'

ambiguities.clause: spec: D in {3, 4}; card and blind inputs: D = [4]
readings: compute D = 4 only, as the card's Q1-Q6 require
ambiguities.chosen: D = 4 for every quantity; D = 3 only in the fixture-dimension self-test

conventions.indices: 0-based; row index = idx(mu)*17 + k; column index = position in descending degrevlex, constant last

conventions.arm: degenerate if x_R in V; else sat iff s >= 1; else unsat
